== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Sector]] Control is an administrative and supervisory entity within the [[Abidan]] organization. It functions as a governing body that monitors various sectors of existence, such as [[Sector Seven]] or [[Sector Twenty]]-one, and manages the stability of different [[Iterations]]. The entity is responsible for addressing violations of cosmic laws, such as individuals attempting to establish unauthorized fiefdoms in different planes. [[Sector]] Control can issue warnings, request immediate responses from [[Judges]] to handle breaches, and oversee the legality of various missions. It maintains headquarters that can be accessed by certain entities to deliver orders. While it provides oversight, its responsiveness and level of intervention can vary depending on the severity of a situation or the specific nature of the crime being investigated.}}
